''See also: [[Transcendent Ruins Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The Transcendent [[Ruins]] are an ancient, massive structure located within the [[Desolate Wilds]]. Appearing as a blunt pyramid or mountain of stacked brown [[stone]], the ruins feature a flat top that reaches into the clouds and an entrance leading to a cavernous interior. They were constructed by masters from an era beyond memory, utilizing complex [[script-circle|script-circles]] that possess immense power. These [[scripts]] allow the ruins to draw [[vital aura]] from hundreds of miles around, a process so intense it can cause local environmental distortions. The structure is considered part of a much larger, world-spanning underground [[labyrinth]] that predates even the [[Dreadgods]] and is notoriously difficult to navigate. A primary attraction of the ruins is a legendary spear, a weapon rumored to have the power to elevate a faction to heavenly status. Legend suggests the ruins rose from the earth on the day a woman died after entering the structure with the spear; some believe she was merely returning a borrowed power or securing her legacy in a [[vault]]. Due to the potential for profit and the secrets held within, the ruins have drawn numerous [[sacred artists]] and warriors. This influx led to the formation of the [[Five Factions Alliance]], a temporary encampment of ramshackle buildings and shops constructed around the base of the structure. While the ruins contain treasures and ancient secrets, they are also a dangerous [[labyrinth]] filled with [[Remnants]] and deadly traps. The structural integrity of the ruins is tied to their powerful [[scripts]], which are so volatile that any significant disruption could cause a detonation capable of destroying the [[Desolate Wilds|Wilds]].}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Constructed by masters from an age beyond memory, the Transcendent [[Ruins]] serve as a dark and deadly [[labyrinth]] left behind by ancient powerhouses. This location draws [[vital aura]] from hundreds of miles around and houses at least four floors near its entrance. The site currently serves as the encampment for the [[Five Factions Alliance]]. During the expedition, a party led by [[Jai Long]] successfully reached the summit of the ruins.}}
